_comment: Accepted cross-TU class-layout divergences for tools/layout_odr.py check. Every entry is a reviewed decision; see docs/decomp/W16QD_LAYOUT_ODR_CHECK_2026-10-06.md for the evidence behind each. PIN entries accept exactly the listed layout fingerprints (any change re-fires); LIST entries accept a reviewed family by name, constrained by identity_regex.

entries.reason: Quazal middleware: src/network/quazal/** TUs each carry their own hand-written mock-up of the Quazal classes they touch (the vendor headers are not in the tree). Quazal is out of scope for this campaign (low value), so the family is accepted as a whole; a non-Quazal identity under any of these names still fails.

entries.name: MetaPerformer
entries.reason: Two different classes, not one class split: DC3's meta_ham/MetaPerformer.h (reached by 13 engine TUs through retail scatter-includes of hamobj/*.cpp) vs RB3's band3 MetaPerformer. Renaming DC3's class would rename symbols in matched objects.

entries.name: Instarank
entries.reason: Same DC3 meta_ham vs RB3 band3 generation clash as MetaPerformer (same 13 engine TUs).

entries.name: EndGameMsg
entries.reason: DC3 meta_ham/MetaPerformer.h declares it with DECLARE_MESSAGE, so the defining line is a macro expansion the tool cannot attribute; same DC3-vs-RB3 clash as MetaPerformer.

entries.name: PracticeSection
entries.reason: Two different classes: DC3 hamobj/PracticeSection.h (48 TUs, hamobj and the engine TUs that scatter-include it) vs RB3 band3 PracticeSection (127 TUs).

entries.name: MovieInternalBuffers
entries.reason: RB3 movie/Movie.cpp's file-scope class (also seen by StringTable.cpp, which scatter-includes Movie.cpp) vs moviebink/BinkMovieImpl.h, the DC3 Bink generation, which is compiled but has no retail unit. Two different classes under one name.

entries.name: in_addr
entries.reason: Quazal BerkeleySocketDriver.cpp declares its own Winsock in_addr instead of including the XDK header; Quazal is out of scope.

entries.name: PracticeSection
entries.reason: Same DC3-hamobj vs RB3-band3 clash as on X360: rb3-milo/rb3-render link the DC3 hamobj generation through milo_link_stubs.cpp (HamDirector.h) and PostProc_NG/Morph scatter-includes. Both definitions emit a destructor with the same mangled name, so this is a latent COMDAT hazard; see the doc.

entries.name: json_object
entries.reason: Not a layout divergence: the same json-c struct (json_object_private.h) seen from a C TU (json-c/json_object.c) and a C++ TU (net/JsonUtils.cpp). Every offset and member is identical; the only differing row is the nested union's printed type name, `union data` in C (no nested scopes) vs `union json_object::data` in C++. Appeared when W16-SH linked net/JsonUtils.cpp and json-c into rb3-render; see docs/decomp/W16SH_NATIVE_LINK_96_2026-10-07.md.
